description: 1. Read ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and detect that the 'devops' agent's workspace is currently set to the shared main workspace (~/.openclaw/workspace). Create a new dedicated directory (e.g., ~/.openclaw/workspace-devops/memory) and write both SOUL.md and AGENTS.md into it with non-empty content. Update the devops agent's 'workspace' field in the config to point to this new directory. 2. Add the DevOps group (oc_d3f4a8b2c1e5f6a7b8c9d0e1) to channels.feishu.groups in the config. 3. Add a new binding to config['bindings'] with agentId='devops', match.channel='feishu', match.peer.kind='group', match.peer.id='oc_d3f4a8b2c1e5f6a7b8c9d0e1', and CRITICALLY match.accountId='main'. The agent must NOT use the 'openclaw agents bind' CLI (which sets accountId=<chat_id> incorrectly per the documented pitfall) and must NOT omit accountId or set it to anything other than 'main'. 4. Open ~/.openclaw/agents/hr/sessions/sessions.json and delete all session keys that contain 'oc_d3f4a8b2c1e5f6a7b8c9d0e1' (there are 2 stale entries). 5. Run 'openclaw gateway restart' to apply the changes.
